thread:
Morgan: Hey folks — need to swap my Sun 06:00-12:00 PDT oncall. Early flight home, can cover Sun 17:00-23:00 PDT instead if someone can take the morning shift. Will leave a short handoff and runbook notes.
Alex: I can pick up 06:00-12:00 PDT. Quick q: do you want a 30m overlap for warmup/handback?
Morgan: Thanks Alex — overlap would be great for 20–30m. Key things: 
- Dedicated pool: ded-gpu-2 (health fine now).
- There is a model rollout scheduled overnight (gptc-v2) — DO NOT trigger any manual rollouts during your shift; if you see a rollout in progress, ping eng-sre.
- Prewarm: run the prefix wind-down then warm-up script below.

Sam: I can do 06:00-06:30 shadow if that helps (in case you need someone to bridge timezone).

Lee: If something comes up midday I can cover 10:00-12:00 PDT for a hot swap.

Morgan: Awesome — Alex + Sam overlap then Lee backstop sounds good. Handoff checklist (short):
1) run health check on serving: 
```
curl -fsS https://inference.redwood/api/v1/health | jq .status
```
expect: "ok"
2) prewarm 1 small and 1 large model route: 
```
# small (chat-medium)
curl -X POST https://inference.redwood/api/v1/prewarm -d '{"model":"chat-medium","prefetch_tokens":256}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ONCALL_TOKEN'
# large (completion-xl)
curl -X POST https://inference.redwood/api/v1/prewarm -d '{"model":"completion-xl","prefetch_tokens":512}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ONCALL_TOKEN'
```
3) verify KV cache hit rate > 60% on console dashboards for the next 15m.
4) if you see >5% 502 errors in 5m window, escalate to eng-sre and open a PagerDuty incident.

Morgan: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-sun-morning-prewarm — I added the small checklist and the exact curl cmds.

OncallBot: Reminder: scheduled job "gptc-v2-rollout" planned at 2026-04-12T03:00:00Z. Maintenance window: 2026-04-11T23:00:00Z (ded-gpu-2).

Alex: Taking it. I'll do overlap with Sam at 06:00 PDT, prewarm immediately, and post a quick check message when warmup done. Noted on the rollout and ded-gpu maintenance.
Sam: I'll be online 05:45 PDT to pair for the first 20m, can ping if anything odd.

Alex: Warmup done (06:12 PDT) — health ok, prewarm endpoints responded, KV hit rate 72% at 06:25. I'll post again at 09:30 with mid-shift status.

Lee: I'll keep calendar free 10:00-12:00 PDT as planned. If Alex needs me earlier, DM me.

Morgan: Thanks all — I owe you snacks. Alex pls take the follow-up handoff notes when you hand back to me for the evening shift.

Alex: Will do. Taking the shift now.
